tasks.short: Evaluate power production and demand trends for operational opportunities.

steps.what: Verify actual power output, fuel input, availability and demand records with their time intervals
inputs: actual plant historian output and fuel records

steps.what: Compare power and demand trends using native interval alignment and checked operating ratios
inputs: manager-approved units, time windows and ratio definitions
outputs: manager-checked trend comparisons and data exceptions

steps.what: Evaluate causes and select realistic operational improvement opportunities
inputs: manager-checked trend comparisons and data exceptions
actual fuel quality and operating context

steps.what: Write and approve the actual opportunity assessment with source periods and uncertainties
inputs: manager-checked trend comparisons and data exceptions
outputs: approved final power trend opportunity assessment

steps.what: Save the approved final trend opportunity assessment
inputs: approved final power trend opportunity assessment

tasks.design: Configure native {PLANT_HISTORIAN} trend comparisons, denoted OTHER, with checked interval alignment and ratio definitions. The manager verifies records and interprets operational causes; charts do not propose or execute control settings. Final assessment writing and separate same-system save stay full.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual output and demand intervals may be compared repeatedly by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native historian charts and numeric ratios can reuse checked time-series records.
tasks.still_hard: Separating demand, fuel quality and equipment causes and judging feasible changes.
tasks.human_edge: The manager understands the physical process behind a trend.
tasks.altitude: Human operational opportunity evaluation with exact trend comparisons.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: plant historians can align recorded intervals and display configured numeric trends.

assumptions: All shares are provisional; credit only residual manual comparison after current historian charts. Existing telemetry, charts and runtime earn no new saving.

Existing plant/dispatch records supply interval_start/end, power_output, fuel_input, availability and actual_demand with units. s1 retains full verification and missing-value investigation; s2 retains 10 hours for ratio/interval checks. Missing compatible data uses manual analysis.
No new baseline, counterfactual output or price is invented. s4 records actual source_period, interpretation and uncertainty at full time. Save stays fully retained.
research_questions: Which production-versus-demand comparisons still require manual interval alignment?

incremental.description: Maintain trend units, interval mappings and ratio definitions

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final power trend opportunity assessment

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only trend comparison changes: 25 times 60% = 15 hours less 1 upkeep = 14. Low halves this benefit: 7.5 minus 1 = 6.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect gasification processes, equipment and facilities for capacity and operating cost improvements.

steps.what: Inspect the actual biomass gasification process, equipment and facility conditions
Capture inspection findings and verify related throughput, downtime and actual cost records
inputs: existing actual historian, maintenance and cost records
outputs: manager-checked inspection and operating cost source set

steps.what: Compare checked equipment throughput and cost evidence using native asset-linked operating views
inputs: manager-checked inspection and operating cost source set

steps.what: Judge opportunities and write and approve actual inspection conclusions and limitations
outputs: approved final gasification inspection opportunity record

steps.what: Save the approved final gasification inspection opportunity record
inputs: approved final gasification inspection opportunity record

tasks.design: Configure native asset-linked views across {PLANT_HISTORIAN} and {MAINTENANCE_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER, with actual ERP costs. Physical inspection and actual finding capture stay full. Numeric comparisons assist capacity/cost investigation; the manager chooses conclusions. Separate same-system save earns no benefit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relating actual inspected equipment to operating and maintenance cost records can require repeated manual comparison.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset/time views can compare checked existing records.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising physical process constraints and workable improvements.
tasks.human_edge: The manager connects plant condition with practical capacity and maintenance limitations.
tasks.altitude: Physical gasification inspection with checked operating evidence.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: asset-linked operating views can compare recorded throughput, downtime and actual costs.

assumptions: Provisional shares require observed residual comparison after current native views; physical inspection and existing sensor runtime earn no new benefit.

s2 captures actual asset_id, observation_time, observed_condition and suspected_constraint at full time. Historian/maintenance/finance owners supply normal existing throughput, downtime and actual_cost records. No invented savings baseline or new upstream reporting is assumed.

s3 retains 10 hours for mapping and comparison checks; missing asset linkage or cost basis requires manual analysis. s4 retains judgement and writing; no control setting or maintenance release is issued. Save stays full.
unknowns: Asset/time alignment of costs and operating records
research_questions: Can existing native views connect the inspected equipment with actual throughput and cost records?

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final actual gasification inspection record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only comparison changes: 20 times 50% = 10 hours less 1 upkeep = 9. Low halves comparison benefit: 5 minus 1 = 4.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare reports on biomass plant operations, status and maintenance.

steps.what: Verify actual reporting-period production, plant status, maintenance events and unresolved issues
inputs: actual maintenance work orders and cost records

steps.what: Populate report tables and exact status fields from checked operational and maintenance records
Draft and correct operational commentary against actual event records and figures
outputs: complete corrected biomass plant report draft

loop.purpose: Draft commentary describing actual operations and maintenance events
loop.input: checked actual figures, event records and factual report tables
loop.output: candidate commentary with record and figure references
loop.check: Manager checks every event, number, period, planned/completed distinction, omission and causal assertion against actual sources and corrects the report
loop.stop: Missing event evidence, unsupported causation or two failed corrections returns commentary to manager
loop.why_not_simpler: Native tables handle exact fields first; variable event explanations need semantic drafting and full correction

steps.what: Approve the complete final report, period, figures and internal recipients
inputs: complete corrected biomass plant report draft
outputs: approved final plant report and recipients

steps.what: Save the approved final biomass plant report
inputs: approved final plant report and recipients

steps.what: Send the approved final plant report to its approved internal recipients
inputs: approved final plant report and recipients

tasks.design: Configure native report templates across {PLANT_HISTORIAN} and {MAINTENANCE_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER, before a bounded commentary loop in {DOCS}. Manager checks source records, corrects prose and approves the complete final report before separate save and internal send. Both final actions remain full.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual operations and maintenance fields may be manually copied into periodic reports.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can reuse exact records and a bounded draft can phrase source-grounded commentary.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting operating events and knowing whether causes are established.
tasks.human_edge: The manager distinguishes actual facts, unresolved causes and planned work.
tasks.altitude: Verified plant reporting with factual assembly and checked prose.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native operating/maintenance report templates can reuse checked records; bounded prose drafting needs full manager correction.

assumptions: All shares are provisional; confirm remaining manual assembly after current report functions. Existing scheduled reports earn no saving.

Plant/maintenance/finance owners supply normal existing period, output, outage_time, event_id, work_order_id, actual_status and actual_cost records. s1 retains full checking and capture of manager observations and unresolved issues. Missing fields require manual reporting.

s3 retains 15 hours for full meaning, figure and omission correction; s4 retains 20 for final report review. No new causal diagnosis or uncounted alert is introduced. Changed report or audience returns to s4; same-system save and send receive no benefit.
research_questions: Which plant report fields are still copied after current native reporting, and does corrected commentary save total effort?

incremental.description: Audit commentary omissions and maintain report source mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final biomass plant report and period
s4 complete final biomass report and exact internal recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 30 factual assembly and 10 corrected prose hours less 2 upkeep = 38. Low halves factual assembly only and keeps prose manual: 15 minus 2 = 13. Save and send remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Manage biomass plant parts and supply inventories.

steps.what: Check actual stock, consumption, critical spares and open receipts against physical inventory
inputs: existing stock movements, equipment requirements and open orders

steps.what: Compare checked stock, reservations and approved reorder rules using native inventory planning
inputs: existing manager-approved reorder rules and lead times
outputs: manager-checked replenishment candidates and inventory exceptions

steps.what: Populate a draft replenishment order from selected exact catalogue parts and quantities
inputs: manager-checked replenishment candidates and inventory exceptions
existing checked supplier catalogue and current terms
outputs: complete candidate plant inventory replenishment order

steps.what: Select and approve the complete final replenishment order, supplier, quantities, compatibility and price
inputs: complete candidate plant inventory replenishment order
outputs: approved final replenishment order and supplier

steps.what: Send the approved final replenishment order to its approved supplier
inputs: approved final replenishment order and supplier

steps.what: Check actual supplier acceptance, promised delivery and any substitutions
Write and approve actual inventory exceptions and replenishment status changes
outputs: approved final actual inventory status entry

steps.what: Save the approved final inventory status entry
inputs: approved final actual inventory status entry
outputs: saved actual inventory and replenishment status

tasks.design: Configure {ERP} native reorder comparisons and {PROCUREMENT} exact catalogue order drafts. OTHER denotes the existing {MAINTENANCE_SYSTEM} critical-spares requirements. The manager counts/checks stock and selects a complete final order before separate supplier send. Actual acceptance is checked later; status save stays full.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock comparisons and replenishment fields may be repeatedly copied despite existing catalogue records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reorder rules, draft orders and reviewed supplier dispatch can remove exact repeated actions.
tasks.still_hard: Critical-spares judgement, actual count discrepancies and compatible substitutions.
tasks.human_edge: The manager understands downtime consequences and whether a part is genuinely suitable.
tasks.altitude: Verified inventory management with native replenishment preparation.

evidence.claim: Inventory planning products support stock planning; exact plant catalogue order configuration remains a proposed local design.
Model knowledge: ERP reorder rules and procurement templates can prepare exact selected replenishment lines.

assumptions: All shares are provisional; observe remaining manual comparisons, order copying and real supplier dispatch after current native features. Existing auto-replenishment earns no new saving; same-system save earns none.

s1 retains full actual capture/checking of part_id, counted_quantity, reserved_quantity, consumption and critical_requirement. Manager verifies existing min_stock and lead_time rules in s1-s2; missing rules require manual selection. Supplier supplies current catalogue part_id, price and terms; no uncounted rule or sold-out flag creation is assumed.

s4 selects quantities, checks compatibility, supplier, final price and actual purchasing authority. Changed terms or substitutions return to final review before any new send. s5 only dispatches the exact reviewed order; s6 checks actual response and s7 records actual status, not delivered stock before receipt.
The proposed 5 send hours mean actual residual manual recipient/attachment dispatch, not a same-system save click or system runtime; verify that work exists or remove that benefit.
research_questions: Which inventory comparisons and order dispatch actions remain manual after current ERP/procurement configuration?

incremental.description: Maintain reorder and catalogue mappings and audit approved dispatches

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final priced replenishment order and exact supplier
s7 actual final inventory and replenishment status entry

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 12 comparison, 15 order-copy and 5 real dispatch hours less 2 upkeep = 30. Low halves only order-copy benefit and keeps comparison/send manual: 7.5 minus 2 = 5.5. Same-system save gets no saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
